SELECT join_date, COUNT(*) AS version_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT member_key, member_id, join_date, tier, home_store_id, marketing_consent, valid_from, valid_to, is_current
FROM dim_member
WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25')
ORDER BY member_id, valid_from

WITH first_version AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS rn
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS new_members,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN valid_from <> join_date THEN member_id END) AS valid_from_differs
FROM first_version
WHERE rn = 1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-09-25'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, MIN(valid_from) AS min_vf, MAX(valid_from) AS max_vf, MAX(join_date) AS max_join,
  SUM(CASE WHEN valid_from < join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vf_before_join
FROM dim_member
